Who is Marge Simpson?

Marjorie BouvierMarge BouvierMomMotherMamaMrs. SimpsonMidge (by Moe)Major MargeChesty LaRueBusty St ClaireHooty McBoobMrs. BossThe blue-haired woman (by Ape Island tribe leader)Mrs. CumberdaleBouffant Betty (by Nigel)Ma Kettle (by Wiggum)Madam President (by her secretary in a potential future)Mommy (by a baby Lisa)Marjorie OctoberMarge OctoberMiss OctoberConstance Prudence Chastity GoodfaithMarge Obedience Temperance Sexwon'tKelly Marge BoobierLa Dama Azul}}

Marjorie "Marge" Bouvier Simpson (née Bouvier) is the mother of the Simpson family. She and her husband Homer have three children: Bart, Lisa, and Maggie. Marge is the homemaker and moralistic force in her family and often provides a raspy and grounding voice in the midst of her family's antics by trying to maintain order in the Simpson household. Aside from her duties at home, Marge has flirted briefly with a number of careers ranging from a police officer to an anti-violence activist.

She is voiced by Julie Kavner, who also voiced her sisters Patty and Selma Bouvier and her mother Jacqueline Bouvier. Kristen Bell voiced her singing voice in "The Star of the Backstage", who also voiced Harper Jambowski in "Friend with Benefit".

Homer and Marge are the same age. The two have a floating timeline, making their birth and childhood difficult to place. Homer said he was 24 years old in 1980. In the 2000s, Homer mentioned being ten years old in "the '60s or '50s, or maybe it was the early '70s". Homer and Marge were in high school anywhere from 1974 to 1999. They were also depicted as young adults in the mid to late 1990s. Marge was also stated to be 4 years old in 1983.

Also known as: Marge, Marjorie Simpson.
